metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a collection of proven exercises that target the main muscles responsible for neck and shoulder pain—designed to deliver fast relief, even in as little as 30 seconds.

Each exercise works differently, targeting specific muscles from various positions. For the best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and feel neck and shoulder pain melt away in seconds!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:34 Quick Relief Stretch 1
2:43 Quick Relief Stretch 2
4:36 Upper Trapezius Release
6:48 Levator Scapulae Release
8:35 Strengthening Exercise
